onboarding.step1Desc: Your local-first Kanban board backed by plain Markdown files in ./tasks/. Zero database, zero lock-in, versioned with git.
onboarding.step2Desc: Drag and drop tasks between columns, track checklist progress, and use inline syntax like #tag, @assignee, or p1 on creation.
onboarding.step3Desc: Press Cmd/Ctrl + K anytime for the Command Palette. Launch AI agents directly on tasks to automate your workflow.

settings.appearanceDesc: Theme, skin, background, font, and language.
settings.agentDesc: Rules and instructions generated for AI agents when running kandown work.
settings.boardDesc: Task id behavior and board-level defaults.
settings.fieldsDesc: Optional fields shown on tasks and board cards.
settings.notificationsDesc: Browser and in-page signals for file changes while the board is open.
settings.languageDesc: UI language stored in this project config.
settings.modeDesc: Auto follows your system light or dark preference.
settings.skinDesc: Color tokens are stored per project in kandown.json.
settings.backgroundDesc: Choose a flat surface or animated liquid background.
settings.fontDesc: Local system font stack, with no network request.
settings.onboardingTourDesc: Re-open the 3-step welcome modal that introduces Kandown the first time you load a project. Each project remembers whether you have seen it.
settings.suggestFollowUpDesc: Ask agents to propose next tasks after finishing one.
settings.maxSuggestionsDesc: Caps the number of follow-up tasks an agent may propose.
settings.permissionModeDesc: How much approval agents get in kandown-driven sessions. Yolo lets the harness apply edits directly, git is the safety net. Accept edits asks before each change when the harness supports it, and stays advisory otherwise.
settings.autopilotMaxParallelDesc: How many tasks the autopilot daemon runs at the same time (1 to 8).
settings.autopilotSessionTokenCapDesc: Token budget for one autopilot session; the daemon stops the session when it is reached. 0 means no cap.
settings.autopilotRunTokenCapDesc: Token budget for the whole autopilot run across all sessions; the daemon winds the run down when it is reached. 0 means no cap.
settings.autopilotRunCostCapUsdDesc: Cost budget in US dollars for the whole autopilot run; the daemon winds the run down when it is reached. 0 means no cap.

harnesses.title: Agent harnesses
harnesses.description: Kandown drives coding agent CLIs that are already installed and already authenticated on this machine. It never asks for an API key.

harnesses.needsDaemonBody: Run npx kandown in this project to start the daemon: it detects installed harnesses and runs agent sessions.

settings.columnsDesc: Comma-separated board columns stored in kandown.json.

settings.defaultOwnerDesc: Initial owner for new tasks when the Owner field is enabled.

settings.toolsDesc: Enable free-form tool hints for AI-agent tasks.
settings.notificationPermissionDesc: Allow the browser to show desktop notifications for this open project.
settings.browserNotificationsDesc: Show a desktop notification when a selected task event happens and permission is granted.
settings.statusChangeNotificationsDesc: Notify when a task moves between board columns.
settings.taskEditNotificationsDesc: Notify when a task file changes on disk after a 2 second debounce.
settings.subtaskNotificationsDesc: Notify when a subtask changes from open to done.
settings.notificationSoundDesc: Play an in-page sound for enabled notification events while the board tab is open.
settings.notificationSoundChoiceDesc: Choose the generated audio cue used for in-page notifications.
settings.notificationPermissionDenied: Browser notifications are blocked in Chrome settings

settings.autoUpdateDescription: Kandown auto-updates when you run npx kandown. To force an update, run: npm install -g kandown
settings.hoverForHelp: Hover or tab through another option to update this help panel.
settings.themesDesc: Browse the community theme store, install curated + community themes, and open the floating editor to tweak or propose your own.
settings.categoryChipsDesc: Give every category a stable hash-derived color and icon. Off keeps the plain monochrome labels.
